description: Tooltip root. Bakes in the Radix Provider so a single `<Tooltip>` is self-contained — no app-level provider required. Controlled via `open`/`onOpenChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`.

usage.when: Name an icon-only control, or add a short hint that appears on hover and keyboard focus.
usage.whenNot: Anything interactive, text people need to finish a task, or a hint touch users must see (touch has no hover).

useInstead.reason: interactive or longer content that opens on click
a hint that must stay visible
